title: Villagers and family protest boy's death in Baleshwar

tea.why: Locals and family protested the death of a 13-year-old boy allegedly beaten over a biscuit theft.
tea.want: Demonstrators demanded justice and strict action against those responsible for the boy's death.
tea.changed: Nov 16: Police arrested a shop owner and his son after a 12-hour protest by villagers and family.

summary: Villagers and family members in Baleshwar, Odisha, staged a 12-hour dharna with the body of a 13-year-old boy who was allegedly beaten to death by a shop owner and his son over the theft of a packet of biscuits. The protest took place following the discovery of the minor's body inside an under-construction house near the shop at Tentuli Bazaar. The demonstrators demanded justice and strict action against the accused. According to news reports, the protest ended after senior officials of the district administration intervened and assured the protesters that strict action would be taken. Police subsequently registered a murder case, arrested the two suspects, and produced them before a court following a complaint from the victim's relative.
response: According to the sources, district administration officials intervened and assured protesters of strict action, leading to the end of the dharna. Police registered a murder case and arrested two suspects.

updates.text: Villagers and family members staged a 12-hour dharna with the boy's body demanding action.
Police arrested a shop owner and his son after district administration officials intervened.
